tei:div.tei:p: rdzong 'phrang las byang dngos grub rol pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/ ston pa kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' che// rab dgyes rdo rje dpal ldan seng ge 'od// mkhas pa mi bzhi zhang drung ye shes sde// gnubs chen yab sras rnams la gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma dbang rgyal tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang*// ldan btson ye shes dbang phyug se ston pa// dngos grub nyang ral 'gro mgon chos dbang zhabs// pad+ma dbang chen rnams la= shes rab rgya mtsho zur haṃ shākya 'byung*// shāka rdor bshes dpal gnyis dang ra legs zung*/ rin rgyal mnga' ris paṇa chen ngag gi dbang*// tshe bstan rgyal po rnam la= nam mkhar spyod pa pa ra hi ta dang*// phris lhun grub 'gyur med rdo rje'i zhabs/ rin chen rnam rgyal o rgyan rig pa 'dzin// theg mchog bstan 'dzin rnams la= /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rig 'dzin rgyal po dang*// mi 'gyur phan bde pad+ma 'gro 'dul rtsal/ kun mkhyen bla ma rig pa'i rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma badz+ra rnam la=(110) yang na/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dab/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs/ bka' drin mnyam med 'khor lo'i mgon po mchog thub bstan lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// mkhan chen rgyal mtshan 'od zer dpal bzang po// gdod ma'i mgon po kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= rje btsun mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag mgon rnams la// bzod med gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na// tshad med thugs rje chen pos nyer dgongs te/ bdag rkyad byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol// tshe 'di'i mngon zhen ldog par byin gyis rlobs// bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog shes= /byang chub sems gnyis 'byung bar= smin grol lam la 'jug par= bskyed rdzogs zab gnad rtogs par byin gyis= bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin par= sku bzhi'i rgyal srid zin par= rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//
zhes pa'ang btsun pa gzhan phan mtha' yas pas snying nas gsol ba gtab pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// dge'o// 'di yi brgyud 'debs zhal bkang mdzad pa po ni/ kun mkhyen bla ma pad+ma ma ṇi'o/// /
